name: stationary_feedback_analysis02
purpose: Follow-up analytical hypothesis check: leaky attitude-assisted request versus registered previous formulas. Not a flight, acceptance gate or training recipe.
source_observation: Analysis01 retained all 324 trajectories: attitude-assisted requests remove steady bias in many cases but delayed cases can oscillate. Add fixed leakage, rather than a gain sweep.
scope: One-axis linear surrogate with attitude lag, sampled delayed requests and constant attitude-estimation disturbance. It cannot establish actual MuJoCo or hardware performance.

equations.attitude_input_mapping: estimated_acceleration = -g*tan(pitch) for forward, -g*tan(roll) for left; small-angle command proxy, no truth input needed by teacher formula
equations.attitude_leaky: request = 0.6 * captured_velocity + 0.9 * captured_estimated_acceleration; equivalently 0.9 * previous-request proxy - 0.3 * captured velocity

report: last ten seconds speed RMS and maximum
limitations: no camera, VLA, EKF, noise, rotation, vertical flight or battery
does not replace existing flight score
no new runtime gains or code
no model training or checkpoint selection
analytic_steady_state: For this linear model, v_inf=(1-0.9)/(1-0.6)*disturbance = 0.25*disturbance. Delay stability is not guaranteed by this identity.
